example.en: When I got to the station, the train had already left.

items.term: had never… before (I had never seen snow before)

example.en: I had never seen snow before I moved to Canada.
example.es: Nunca había visto la nieve antes de mudarme a Canadá.

items.term: past perfect for the earlier reason (I was hungry because I hadn't eaten)
items.es: pasado perfecto para la causa, que pasó antes

example.en: I was tired because I hadn't slept well.
example.es: Estaba cansado porque no había dormido bien.

items.term: after + past perfect (after she had left)

example.en: After she had finished her homework, she went out.
example.es: Después de terminar la tarea, salió.

passages.title: A terrible morning
passages.text: Last Monday was a disaster for Paul. He woke up late because he had forgotten to set his alarm. By the time he got to the bus stop, the bus had already left, so he took a taxi. When he arrived at the office, he realized that he had left his laptop at home. He went back to get it, and when he returned, the meeting had already finished. "I had never had a morning like that before," he said.
